level_id_bank.verdict: position_status CLOSED -- a level map, not a live position. THE SETUP IS A COMPRESSION, NOT A DIRECTION: price sits in a fib-bounded box only 3.5% tall with a narrow daily Bollinger band, which is a pre-expansion shape and says nothing about which way. Do NOT pre-position inside it. THE TWO TRIGGERS, both objective: (1) LONG on a daily close above 89.97 (the box ceiling), stop a daily close below 86.72 (the doubly-defended floor) -- from ~90.5 with a stop at 86.4, risk 4.1 -> T1 93.94 = 0.8R, T2 96.10-97.34 (the BMSB inside the box) = 1.5-1.7R, T3 98.90 = 2.0R. The whole trade is the reclaim of the wall, so it is a 2R trade at best and should be sized as one. (2) SHORT/AVOID on a daily close below 86.72: next structure is 84.84, then the deep box 77.10-80.81, which is where the better long actually lives. WHAT WOULD CHANGE THE NAME: a WEEKLY close above 97.34 puts price back inside the BMSB for the first time in this decline. That is the level worth an alert, not the box edges.
